The '''Arming Stud''' was a component used on [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]]. The component was located in the groove between the base of the [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] and the flared main body containing the [[energy envelope projector]] and [[proton-scattering energy warhead]].<ref name="EGWT" />
